answer: Tundra escrow staking: an agent locks 1,500 POA in a Zenith escrow vault for 90 days to earn one wander work permit, and the stake is slashed 50% if the agent is caught submitting duplicate work. A permit cannot be split or transferred, so fielding 500 fake agents locks 750,000 POA for three months and risks 375,000 POA in slashing, while one honest agent locks one stake and earns it back in full.
